node.label: Reduced acetylglucosamine-6-sulfatase activity in cultured fibroblasts
node.definition: Concentration or activity of N-acetylglucosamine-6-sulfatase (EC 3.1.6.14) as measured in cultured fibroblasts is below the limits of normal. N-acetylglucosamine-6-sulfatase hydrolyzes heparan sulfate and keratan sulfate.

evidence.snippet: Mucopolysaccharidosis, type IIID: Reduced acetylglucosamine-6-sulfatase activity in cultured fibroblasts [TAS]
